turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me solve one first.
I work from home. My friend works from home.
Step 1: "my friend" is one person, like he or she.
Step 2: one person (not I or you), so I add -s: works.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He works at a bank. Wrong: He work at a bank.

Now try this one. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
